gloss: wasabi pickles; wasabi preserved in sake lees

definitions.gloss: wasabi pickles; wasabi preserved in sake lees
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese pickle made by chopping wasabi stems, leaves, and roots and preserving them in sake lees (kasuzuke). A specialty of Shizuoka Prefecture, where most Japanese wasabi is grown.

examples.japanese: {山葵漬|わさびづ}けをお{土産|みやげ}に{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought wasabi pickles as a souvenir.

examples.japanese: {山葵漬|わさびづ}けは{白|しろ}いご{飯|はん}との{相性|あいしょう}がいい。
examples.english: Wasabi pickles go well with plain white rice.

examples.japanese: {静岡|しずおか}に{行|い}ったら、{本場|ほんば}の{山葵漬|わさびづ}けをぜひ{試|ため}してみてください。
examples.english: If you go to Shizuoka, be sure to try the authentic local wasabi pickles.

notes:
Compound of {山葵|わさび} (wasabi) and {漬|づ}け (pickled; preserved). The suffix ~{漬|づ}け indicates preservation, as in {粕漬|かすづ}け (sake-lees pickling) or {味噌漬|みそづ}け (miso pickling). {山葵漬|わさびづ}け uses the entire wasabi plant — not just the root commonly served with sushi.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山葵漬|わさびづ}けを{作|つく}る: to make wasabi pickles
- {本場|ほんば}の{山葵漬|わさびづ}け: authentic wasabi pickles
- {山葵漬|わさびづ}けの{瓶詰|びんづ}め: bottled wasabi pickles

CULTURAL NOTE:
{山葵漬|わさびづ}け is one of the most popular {土産|みやげ} (souvenirs) from {静岡県|しずおかけん}, particularly from the {伊豆|いず} region. It has a sharp, pungent kick similar to fresh wasabi but mellowed by the sweetness of {酒粕|さけかす} (sake lees).

RELATED WORDS:
- {酒粕|さけかす}: sake lees, the solid residue from sake production
- {漬物|つけもの}: pickled vegetables (the general category)
- {奈良漬|ならづ}け: Nara-style pickles, also made with sake lees
